title: Paper Mario: The Origami King
description: A paper-crafted adventure sends Mario and Olivia across a folded world of streamers, quirky allies, ring-based battles and visual creativity. Explore varied themed regions, rescue Toads, solve environmental puzzles and take on origami enemies and giant bosses as you try to stop King Olly.

gameplayPillars.title: Ring-based battles
gameplayPillars.description: Rearrange circles of enemies to line them up for stronger attacks and more efficient turns.

gameplayPillars.title: Paper-crafted exploration
gameplayPillars.description: Travel through visually distinctive areas, rescue hidden Toads and solve environmental interactions using 1,000-Fold Arms.

gameplayPillars.title: Memorable bosses and companions
gameplayPillars.description: Boss battles and traveling companions add variety, humor and structure throughout the adventure.

gameplayPillars.title: Ring-based battle puzzles
gameplayPillars.description: Regular battles ask players to rotate and slide ring layers so enemies line up efficiently before attacks, turning combat into a positioning puzzle.

gameplayPillars.title: Exploration, secrets, and collectibles
gameplayPillars.description: Large themed regions hide Toad rescues, treasure, optional encounters, and environmental puzzles that reward curiosity beyond the main path.

worldSummary: King Olly’s origami takeover twists Princess Peach’s kingdom into a folded crisis. Mario and Olivia set out across varied regions to remove giant streamers, rescue allies and stop the transformation of the world into origami.

storyChapters.title: The origami threat begins
storyChapters.body: Mario and Luigi arrive for a festival only to discover Princess Peach and the kingdom have been transformed by King Olly.

storyChapters.title: Travel the folded world
storyChapters.body: Mario and Olivia journey through forests, deserts, seas and themed regions while removing magical streamers.

storyChapters.title: Confront King Olly
storyChapters.body: The final stretch unites the game’s humor, emotion and puzzle-combat systems as Mario moves to stop the Origami King.

storyChapters.title: Unfold the crisis across paper kingdoms
storyChapters.body: Mario and Olivia travel through streamers wrapped around Peach's Castle, visiting varied paper-crafted regions to undo King Olly's plans.

storyChapters.title: Rescue allies and confront King Olly
storyChapters.body: The journey mixes humor, boss battles, puzzle solving, and emotional moments before culminating in the showdown against the folded threat.

features: Distinct companions, bosses and environmental puzzles
Inventive ring battles distinguish it from prior entries
Large regions reward exploration and collectible hunting
Memorable boss battles remix the puzzle concept in clever ways

faq.a: It mixes action-adventure structure with puzzle-like ring battles rather than focusing on a classic stat-heavy RPG system.
Its paper-crafted art direction, witty writing and strong world design are the most frequently praised elements.

faq.q: Is The Origami King a turn-based RPG?
faq.a: It has turn-based elements, but its regular battle system is heavily puzzle-based. Exploration, boss design, and story presentation are just as important as combat.

faq.q: Does the game have a large world to explore?
faq.a: Yes. While it is structured by major regions, each area includes side activities, hidden Toads, collectibles, and optional discoveries that reward exploration.

verdictSummary: Overall score: 8.4/10. Strengths include Excellent art direction and world variety; Charming humor and character writing; Strong environmental puzzle design. Main drawbacks include Battle system divides opinion; 30 fps presentation.
verdictPros: Excellent art direction and world variety
Creative art direction gives every region a distinct identity
verdictCons: Progression systems are lighter than classic Paper Mario
Regular battles may divide players who prefer classic RPG combat
Some collectible cleanup can become repetitive late in the game

reviews.quote: Nintendo describes an origami-twisted adventure with ring-based battles and a vibrant paper-crafted world.
Critical reaction was generally favorable, especially for presentation and writing.
The announcement trailer introduced King Olly, Olivia and the folded world premise.
